title: Manipulation of α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor signaling in primary ovine fetal microglia cultures
protocol: Obtain fetal sheep brain tissues during sheep autopsy after completion of the in vivo experiment.
Adapt a human adult and fetal microglia culture protocol to include a myelin removal step following high-speed centrifugation.
Plate fetal sheep cells on poly-L-lysine-coated tissue culture flasks at a concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/ml in DMEM with supplements.
Incubate cells for seven days at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Perform a media change by centrifuging the cells and adding re-suspended cells back to the culture flask.
Continue incubating cells for an additional seven days at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Collect floating microglia carefully to avoid contamination with astrocytes and oligodendrocytes.
Incubate collected cells in a 24-well plate at 1 × 10^5 cells/ml with 5% DMEM for 4-5 days.
Treat cells with or without LPS (100 ng/ml) for 6 hours.
Collect cell conditioned media for cytokine analysis.
Add 0.5 ml TriZol per well for RNA extraction.
Extract total RNA from cultured microglia using TRIzol Reagent.
Quantify RNA quantity and quality using an RNA Nano Chip on Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer.
Prepare RNAseq libraries using Illumina TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation v2 kit.
Perform single-end 50-bp sequencing at high throughput on an Illumina HiSeq2500.
